WITH l AS (SELECT * FROM workspace.airbnb_gold.baseline_lookup WHERE baseline_version='airbnb-v1'),
  x AS (SELECT p.listing_id, p.baseline_prediction_eur, p.baseline_fallback_level,
         coalesce(c.median_price_eur, r.median_price_eur, o.median_price_eur) expected,
         CASE WHEN c.median_price_eur IS NOT NULL THEN 'room_type_x_accommodates' WHEN r.median_price_eur IS NOT NULL THEN 'room_type' ELSE 'overall' END expected_level
       FROM (SELECT * FROM workspace.airbnb_gold.predictions WHERE city='venice' AND snapshot_date=DATE '2026-09-16' AND model_version='price-v1' AND scoring_run_id='venice-2026-09-16-price-v1-score-v1-first-run') p JOIN (SELECT * FROM workspace.airbnb_gold.model_features WHERE city='venice' AND snapshot_date=DATE '2026-09-16') f USING (city, snapshot_date, listing_id)
       LEFT JOIN l c ON c.baseline_level='room_type_x_accommodates' AND c.room_type=f.room_type AND c.accommodates=f.accommodates
       LEFT JOIN l r ON r.baseline_level='room_type' AND r.room_type=f.room_type
       CROSS JOIN (SELECT median_price_eur FROM l WHERE baseline_level='overall') o)
  SELECT count(*) n, count_if(abs(baseline_prediction_eur-expected) > 1e-9) value_mismatch, count_if(baseline_fallback_level <> expected_level) level_mismatch FROM x

label: venice_features
